scope: Source-only native credential-free public HTTPS provider. No app, device, deployment, durable cache or authority changes.

full_connector.note: Before subsequent behavior-preserving Clippy condition rewrite and stronger proxy child-test assertion.

profile.encoding: Identity Content-Encoding only; strict UTF-8 bytes/declaration and XML media-type profile.
profile.addresses: All returned answers validated before deduplication, every hop independently pinned, no fallback resolver, exact actual peer match required. Conservative IANA special-purpose refusal; IPv6 currently allocated RIR prefixes only.
profile.tls: Explicit Rustls; clear all built-in root sources then enable WebPKI only; certificate/hostname verification preserved.
profile.redirects: Relative paths supported; absolute/network-path raw authority validated before parsing; all complete targets rechecked; no query/fragment/backslash/default-port normalization bypass.
profile.state: No activation, credentials, cookie jar, proxy, inherited client/headers, media fetch, XML normalization or cache writes.

evidence_boundaries.real_local_transport: Production reqwest/TLS acquisition code over real loopback sockets with compile-only test-root/address overrides; not live public DNS qualification.
evidence_boundaries.policy_tests: Synthetic address sets, missing/unexpected peers and no-fallback resolver tests; not live adversarial DNS.
evidence_boundaries.resolver_resource_test: Real bounded spawn_blocking lifecycle with a deterministic stalled closure; proves permits survive caller cancellation, not OS DNS correctness.
evidence_boundaries.live_public_transport: One observed external public feed with actual production DNS/TLS/peer validation and no test override; does not prove every public publisher or adversarial public DNS scenario.
evidence_boundaries.native_binding: Separate concrete native factory and actual generated Swift qualification are recorded in feed-native-factory-evidence.json; this transport receipt qualifies the provider itself.
remaining: No durable cache, XML safety or normalized record claim by this adapter.
No browser/WASM transport, UI activation, installed app, device or credentials tested.
OS getaddrinfo cannot be forcibly interrupted; timed-out jobs retain bounded permits until actual completion.
New IANA IPv6 allocations require policy review; special-purpose globally reachable anycast exceptions deliberately refused.

dependencies: Owned by feed_reader_review, not this agent. reqwest remains pinned0.12.28; tokio time/sync enabled; exact tokio-rustls0.26.6 and rcgen0.14.7 are test-only.
